notes: Zara Home India has no dedicated country storefront; per notes/242.md it is served entirely through the shared 'Rest of World' catalogue at https://www.zarahome.com/ww/ (storeId 88009900 / catalogId 80290026), identical to the catalogue served to 139 other countries. Access: curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation solved the Akamai interstitial JS proof-of-work challenge programmatically (same technique as the prior Home-Decor pass's solver, reimplemented here since that script lives in the orchestrator's off-limits pipeline dir) and reached SSR pages fine. Plain Playwright/Chromium (tier 2) was hard-blocked with an Akamai 'Access Denied' page even with anti-automation-detection init scripts and injected cookies from the working curl_cffi session, so tier 2 was abandoned per the 'first block stops that host' rule for that specific method; Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3, real browser fingerprint) was used as last resort only for the client-rendered mega-menu and site-search checks that tier 1's JSON endpoints could not surface (category-tree/menu REST endpoints all returned 404 'no service match'/'category not found' when guessed). robots.txt was fetched in full: no Claude/ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow, and no disallowed path pattern hints at a hidden bestsellers/sale page. CHECKED: (1) Full main nav via real Chrome hamburger menu: 0FR. PARIS and ZARA HOME (collab, editorial), STUDIO MARY LENNOX (collab, editorial), BEDDING, HOME DECOR, BATHROOM, KIDS AND BABY, CLOTHING AND FOOTWEAR, LAUNDRY CARE, CULINARY STORIES (editorial), +INFO, WITHDRAWAL OF ITEMS (fetched via HTTP: confirmed a legal/policy page about withdrawal of items, zero product grid in SSR, and specifically excluded from generic crawling by robots.txt 'Disallow: /*n5187$') -- no Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Popular/Trending/Top Sellers item anywhere. (2) Expanded HOME DECOR and BEDDING submenus fully -- only ordinary product sub-categories, no merchandising concept rows. (3) The WW-specific category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-ww-0.xml.gz, 452 URLs) was downloaded and grepped case-insensitively for sale|new|best|popular|trend|discount|outlet|clearance -- zero matches. (4) 15 direct URL guesses (/ww/best-sellers, /ww/bestsellers, /ww/most-popular, /ww/popular, /ww/trending, etc.) all resolved to the site's own 404 Error Page. (5) Site search (real Chrome, /ww/search.html?term=...) confirmed functional with a real query ('cushion' returned genuine cushion-cover results) but 'bestseller' returned a single unrelated fallback product (a fitted sheet) -- the same non-discriminating fallback the site gives for other absent concepts, not a real hit -- and no PLP resulted. No local-language equivalent needed: this WW catalogue is English-only (languageId -1, en-US) with no India-specific language variant. CONCLUSION: no genuine Bestsellers-type PLP exists on the India-serving WW catalogue. DUPLICATE-RISK NOTE for the orchestrator: because /ww/ (storeId 88009900/catalogId 80290026) is shared verbatim across 140 countries, any other roster company also mapped to this same WW catalogue (e.g. Pakistan, Nigeria, Vietnam) would read this identical absence finding and should be treated as a duplicate determination, consistent with how the Home-Decor pass handled ES/153 vs ES/127.
